tf32.note: Placement precedes actions. Episode 0 of every environment is placed identically in all arms; later reset batches differ by arm because episode lengths differ, so arm independence is supported empirically (start-clearance quantiles below), not by construction. The minimum-clearance check can detect false acceptances only; a false rejection would shift the distribution without lowering the minimum. Excluding 160 bars is a partial sensitivity: the TF32 audit recorded nonzero errors at other densities too.
